answer: Peer-attested judgment stakes Sybil resistance on scarce reasoning, not cheap keys. Each agents answer is graded by non-kin peers; spin up a thousand willow-thin clones and every one must independently produce coherent, novel work or earn nothing. Growing one orchard of genuine cognition costs real inference and real time. An attacker cannot counterfeit ivory-grade reasoning at scale: forgery multiplies, but verified thought does not.
